2608.05790.title: ChainClaw: A Layered Agent Framework for Reliable On-Chain Execution
2608.05790.paper_summary: General-purpose large language model agents have achieved strong performance on tool-augmented tasks, yet they rely on assumptions break down in blockchain environments. On-chain execution is stateful, adversarial, and economically irreversible, exposing three fundamental gaps: Reactivity, Irreversibility, and Observability. We propose ChainClaw, a blockchain-native agent framework built on OpenClaw, that addresses all three gaps through a layered architecture comprising an event-driven orchestration layer, a simulation-based safety intelligence layer, and an on-chain monitoring runtime layer, unified by a cross-layer memory subsystem. ChainClaw closes the Reactivity gap via event ingestion and simulation feedback, the Irreversibility gap via a pre-execution safety pipeline with transaction simulation and action guard, and the Observability gap via an on-chain read adapter and transaction monitor. We evaluate ChainClaw on a purpose-built benchmark covering seven tasks across four categories and five dimensions. ChainClaw consistently outperforms representative baselines on both safety and task completion.
2608.05790.paper_summary_zh: 一般用途的大型語言模型代理在增強工具的任務上表現出色，但它們依賴的假設在區塊鏈環境中會崩潰。鏈上執行是有狀態的、對抗性的，且經濟上不可逆，暴露出三個基本的差距：反應性、不可逆性和可觀察性。我們提出了ChainClaw，一個基於OpenClaw構建的區塊鏈原生代理框架，通過一個分層架構來解決這三個差距，該架構包括一個事件驅動的編排層、一個基於模擬的安全智能層，以及一個鏈上監控運行時層，這些層通過一個跨層內存子系統統一。ChainClaw通過事件攝取和模擬反饋來縮小反應性差距，通過具有交易模擬和行動保護的預執行安全管道來縮小不可逆性差距，並通過鏈上讀取適配器和交易監控來縮小可觀察性差距。我們在一個專門構建的基準上評估ChainClaw，涵蓋四個類別和五個維度的七個任務。ChainClaw在安全性和任務完成上始終超越代表性基準。
